tonight.headline: 51% — a coin flip you can tilt by 2.7 before Wednesday
body: Bad news first: Tuten re-aggravated his ankle (questionable), Taylor ran 11 times for 21 yards and now gets a quarterback making his first start since Jones was released, and Jacobs is unlikely Wednesday. You lost 93.46 to 114.04 and are 3-8.

Week 12 projects 126.8 to 123.8. Golden (16.7) sits on your bench behind Gordon (14.0) and plays Wednesday night: swap him in before 19:00. JuiceJam's Walker (22.0) is benched and questionable — if he plays, they gain about 11.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Golden stays benched past Wednesday 19:00, Walker returns for JuiceJam, and Tuten sits without the fallback being made.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Walker ruled out on Thursday, or Tuten cleared on Friday.

worthALook.name: Antonio Williams
worthALook.lead: A real role on waivers — and a claim would cost you priority for the season.

case.label: The player
case.body: 9 catches for 122 in Week 11, Daniels' most-targeted receiver in any game (DraftSharks 24 Nov); McLaurin's season-ending tear opened the No. 2 job (FantasyPros 24 Nov).

case.label: The cost
case.body: On waivers until Wednesday 02:00 CDMX; a claim drops Bloodsports from 7th to last for the season (STRATEGY §4). He would not start over Golden, Pickens or Wilson.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: He clears waivers and becomes a free agent, and Loveland outscores Odunze again in Week 12 — then add him for Odunze at no priority cost.

worthALook.name: Justice Hill
worthALook.lead: Henry cleared protocol, so Hill is the change-up again.

case.label: The player
case.body: 12 catches in Brissett's two starts; Henry's clean concussion check keeps Hill on passing downs (Yahoo FAAB 24 Nov; NBC 22 Nov).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: FantasyPros calls him fool's gold: no double-digit-carry game this season. Never spend IPADE priority on a change-up back.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Henry setback reported before Sunday.
